name: Grand Seminyak Lifestyle Boutique Bali Resort
short_description: A beachfront lifestyle resort in Seminyak with direct beach access, a 4.5/5 ALL Rating (175 reviews), and the Ocean Grand Beach day club with live entertainment.
ai_summary: Grand Seminyak Lifestyle Boutique Bali Resort sits directly on Seminyak Beach, offering spacious suites amid tropical gardens overlooking the Indian Ocean. The property holds a 4.5/5 ALL Rating from 175 reviews. On-site venues include Moonlite Kitchen and Bar for modern Southeast Asian cuisine and the Ocean Grand Beach day club, which runs daily live entertainment and DJ performances — guests should expect to hear music during operating hours given the resort's lifestyle positioning. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: JL Camplung Tanduk Dhyana Pura, Seminyak Beach, 80361 Seminyak, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Direct beach access on Seminyak Beach — one of Bali's most sought-after beachfront addresses
Ocean Grand Beach day club and Moonlite Kitchen and Bar give the resort a genuine lifestyle/nightlife identity
cons: The resort's day-club and entertainment positioning means daytime noise from live music — not suited to guests wanting a quiet beachfront stay
Seminyak's beachfront strip is busy and commercial rather than secluded
research_highlights: Direct beach access, ALL Rating 4.5/5 (175 reviews)
Ocean Grand Beach day club with daily live entertainment
research_watchouts: Guests may hear music/entertainment during the day club's scheduled operating hours
